events.title: US and Iran exchange strikes
events.description: The US and Iran have exchanged strikes, with the US hitting multiple targets across Iran and Iran launching retaliatory attacks at US infrastructure in Kuwait and Bahrain.

events.title: Pakistani strikes kill dozens in Afghanistan
events.description: Pakistani strikes have killed dozens of people in Afghanistan, with the Taliban government claiming that civilians were targeted and Pakistan maintaining that they targeted militants.

events.title: Israel strikes southern Lebanon
events.description: Israel has struck southern Lebanon, killing at least one person, in response to a framework agreement signed between Lebanon and Israel.

events.title: Australia and Vanuatu sign deal to block foreign military bases
events.description: Australia and Vanuatu have signed a deal to block foreign military bases in the Pacific, with China expressing concern that the agreement may be targeted at it.

events.title: China slaps export controls on dozens of Japanese entities
events.description: China has imposed export controls on dozens of Japanese entities, citing Tokyo's 'new militarism' as the reason for the measures.

events.title: Venezuela earthquakes pose first major test for President Delcy Rodriguez
events.description: The recent earthquakes in Venezuela have posed a major test for President Delcy Rodriguez, with the government facing criticism for its response to the disaster.

events.title: Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine: Council extends economic sanctions
events.description: The Council has extended economic sanctions against Russia for another year, in response to its ongoing war of aggression against Ukraine.

events.title: South Korea announces $880bn chip and AI investment plan
events.description: South Korea has announced a plan to invest $880bn in chip and AI technology, in a bid to secure its position in the industry.
